goal: Implement autonomous 24/7 DCA bot evaluation engine in bot_engine.py and integrate it into market cycle in telegram_bot.py

contracts.interfaces: evaluate_active_dca_bot_tick function signature and return dictionary
function_signatures: evaluate_active_dca_bot_tick(bot: Dict[str, Any], current_price: float, client: Optional[Any] = None, telegram_notifier: Optional[Any] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]

execution_steps: Write unit test in test_dca_bot_engine.py verifying interval check, buy execution, capital limit guardrail, and take profit exit
Run python test_dca_bot_engine.py to verify failure before implementation (red phase)
Integrate DCA bot evaluation in execute_market_evaluation_cycle in telegram_bot.py
Run python test_dca_bot_engine.py to verify green phase
Run lint and typecheck verification commands
acceptance_criteria: evaluate_active_dca_bot_tick executes BUY when interval elapsed or price drop triggered
evaluate_active_dca_bot_tick respects capital_allocated_usd and does not exceed limit
evaluate_active_dca_bot_tick closes open trades with SELL when average entry reaches take profit
telegram_bot.py invokes evaluate_active_dca_bot_tick for active bots with strategy DCA

rollback.command: git checkout HEAD -- bot_engine.py telegram_bot.py; rm -f test_dca_bot_engine.py contracts/TSK-CLOUD-007.contract.json
